nodes.label: Kodak Rate-Distortion Curve (PSNR vs bpp)
nodes.rationale: RD comparison on Kodak, 0.1-1.0 bpp, PSNR 29-38 dB. MLIC++ is best overall (notably ~34.15 dB at ~0.42 bpp), followed by MLIC+ and MLIC; ELIC/STF/VTM-17.0 next; classical BPG, JPEG2000, JPEG far below.

nodes.label: Tecnick Rate-Distortion Curve (PSNR vs bpp)
nodes.rationale: RD comparison on Tecnick, 0.05-0.6 bpp, PSNR 31-38.5 dB. MLIC++ (retrained, up to ~0.29 bpp) and MLIC+ lead at low rates; LIC-TCM Large surpasses MLIC+ above ~0.42 bpp; Xie'21, Minnen'20 and VTM-17.0 cluster lower; JPEG2000 far below.

nodes.label: CLIC Professional Valid Rate-Distortion Curve (PSNR vs bpp)
nodes.norm_label: clic professional valid rate-distortion curve (psnr vs bpp)
nodes.rationale: RD comparison on CLIC Professional Valid, 0.05-0.6 bpp, PSNR 31-38 dB. MLIC++ (retrained, only up to ~0.3 bpp) and MLIC+ lead at low rates; LIC-TCM Large overtakes MLIC+ above ~0.43 bpp; all learned MLIC variants beat VVC and Cheng'20.

nodes.label: Analysis Transform g_a
nodes.rationale: Alternating residual (downsampling) blocks, final Conv3x3 M stride-down, maps x to latent y.

nodes.label: Entropy Parameters g_ep
nodes.rationale: Fuses contexts and hyperprior to output Gaussian (mu, sigma).

nodes.label: Factorized Entropy Model
nodes.rationale: Models hyper-latent z_hat without context.

nodes.label: Hyper Synthesis h_s
nodes.rationale: Conv3x3 stack up to 2M channels producing hyperprior features for g_ep.

nodes.label: Inter Global Context
nodes.rationale: Linear attention across previously decoded slices y^{<i} producing Phi_gc,inter.

nodes.label: Intra Global Context
nodes.rationale: Linear attention within slice i: queries from anchor y_ac^i, keys/values from non-anchor/anchor of slice i-1 (Conv1x1, DWConv3x3, Softmax, Transpose), then Conv5x5 and residual Conv1x1-DWConv-Conv1x1 giving Phi_gc,intra.

nodes.label: MEM++ Multi-reference Entropy Model
nodes.rationale: Combines channel-wise, local spatial, intra-slice global and inter-slice global contexts to predict (mu, sigma).

nodes.label: Synthesis Transform g_s
nodes.rationale: Residual blocks with upsampling and final Conv3x3 3 up, reconstructs x_hat from y_hat.

nodes.label: MLIC++ Architecture Diagram
nodes.rationale: Overall MLIC++ learned image codec: analysis/synthesis transforms, hyperprior, and multi-reference entropy model MEM++ with linear-complexity global context modules.

nodes.label: Softmax Linear Attention (Conv1x1/DWConv3x3/Softmax)
nodes.rationale: Softmax on queries and keys separately with K^T V product first gives linear complexity global context.

nodes.label: LatentResidualPrediction
nodes.rationale: Fixed version (2024-04-08) to be used with updated checkpoint; no performance drop.

nodes.label: enable_channel_context flag
nodes.rationale: Enables/disables channel context attention (default True).

nodes.label: enable_global_inter_context flag
nodes.rationale: Enables/disables global inter-slice attention (default True).

nodes.label: enable_global_intra_context flag
nodes.rationale: Enables/disables global intra-slice attention (default True).

nodes.label: enable_local_context flag
nodes.rationale: Enables/disables local context attention (default True).

nodes.label: MLIC-Train-100K Dataset
nodes.rationale: ~100K training images from DIV2K, Flicker2K, CLIC Train, COCO, ImageNet; JPGs downsampled with PIL ANTIALIAS and stored as PNG; hosted on HuggingFace.

nodes.label: MLICPlusPlus Model Configuration
nodes.rationale: Model hyperparameters N=192, M=320, slice_num=10, context_window=5 plus four boolean flags toggling attention modules for ablation.

nodes.label: BD-Rate Benchmark vs VTM-17.0 Intra
nodes.rationale: MLIC++ achieves -13.39/-17.59/-13.08 % on Kodak/Tecnick/CLIC relative to VTM-17.0 Intra anchor.

nodes.label: Pretrained Checkpoints
nodes.rationale: Old (2023-09) weights for MSE lambdas 0.0018-0.0483 and MS-SSIM lambdas 2.4-60.5 require the *Old modules; checkpoint dict holds epoch, state_dict, loss, optimizer, aux_optimizer, lr_scheduler.

nodes.label: MLIC++ Training Settings
nodes.rationale: Single A100, batch 32, patch 256x256 switched to 512x512 after 1.2M steps; lambda 0.0250 log trained on 4 GPUs with DDP.

nodes.norm_label: mlic training image list (108,012 png files)

nodes.label: MLIC++
nodes.rationale: Linear Complexity Multi-Reference Entropy Modeling (ICML 2023 NCW, Jiang & Wang); solves quadratic complexity of global context capture; 83.5M params after 2024-04 fix.

nodes.label: MLIC: Multi-Reference Entropy Model for Learned Image Compression
nodes.norm_label: mlic: multi-reference entropy model for learned image compression

nodes.label: Attention Module Bypass
nodes.rationale: When a flag is false the corresponding module is bypassed in forward, compress and decompress passes, keeping encoder/decoder consistent.

nodes.label: Linear-Complexity Global Context
nodes.rationale: MLIC++ replaces quadratic-cost global attention with linear-complexity attention to capture global context cheaply.

nodes.label: Residual Block (downsampling)
nodes.rationale: Conv3x3 N stride-down then Conv3x3 N with skip addition.
